thread:
rachel (People Ops): quick post-all-hands note on hiring signals + org ownership questions from the live Q. i'll keep it short and actionable and add links at the end.
drew (Eng): appreciated. two quick things: 1) will we prioritize hiring for mentoring/IC development (junior hires) or speed-of-delivery (senior hires)? 2) any change to time-to-fill targets?
sana (Product): also  curious if hub owners will get dedicated hiring credits for pod-level growth or if it's still centralized.
rachel (People Ops): answers: 1) mix approach: for now committee leans senior for infra/platform where ramp cost is high; for product teams with predictable onboarding pipelines we may allow junior hires if a senior mentor is listed on the form. add "mentor-owner" in the justification. 2) time-to-fill targets not changing, but urgent-offer cases get expedited (48-72h).
liam (Recruiting): to add  we will surface expected ramp time (3mo/6mo) in the tracker so managers can justify junior vs senior. please fill that field in the form.
drew (Eng): good call. on the hub credits  will they be auto-unlocked by bookings or manually approved per case?
rachel (People Ops): hub credits: a hybrid. small credits (<=1 FTE) can be auto-applied when a hub hits its milestone; larger increases need committee signoff. we'll publish the exact thresholds in the FAQ.
sana (Product): will there be any change to who approves cross-hub moves? a few PMs asked about moving folks between hubs for short projects.
rachel (People Ops): short project rotations (<=3 months) can be approved by hub leads and documented in the tracker as "rotation". anything longer becomes a transfer and goes through the normal backfill review. ops-bot will tag rotations.
hiring-bot: [automated] hiring form: https://redwood/hire-form | tracker: https://redwood/hire-tracker | deadline: Fri 5pm PT
liam (Recruiting): one process note: please keep interview scorecards updated with expected 3-month impact and mentor-owner. it helps reduce back-and-forth in committee meetings.
drew (Eng): last q  any change to relocation or sign-on authority? some managers asked about faster approvals for critical hires.
rachel (People Ops): no broad change. standard packages apply; exceptions for strategic hires can be approved by the People Ops lead + finance on a case basis. tag me for those and i'll route them.
noah (CEO): quick context: the goal here is to be deliberate, not slow. we want to minimize churn and hire where we get the most leverage. managers: focus on measurable outcomes and mentorship plans in your forms.
rachel (People Ops): i'll post a 1-pager and the tracker link in #all-hands in 30m and pin it. DM for urgent approvals. :white_check_mark:
